HELLO FROM THE STUDIO

A little imagination,
on a sheet of paper.

Patrick’s Little Studio is a small collection of playful printable mandalas for kids. Simple shapes and friendly characters are at the heart of every page.

Who is Patrick?

Patrick is the studio’s fictional host, brought to life with an AI-created portrait. Behind the character is a real collection of printable designs, selected and prepared for coloring.

How the drawings are made

These designs are created with generative AI from individual creative briefs. The briefs specify circular compositions, a clear central motif, black outlines, large coloring spaces, and simpler geometric surroundings. The selected images are checked visually and prepared as printable PDFs in two paper sizes.

What makes this collection different?

The collection starts with just seven drawings. Each has its own subject and coloring idea, without an overwhelming catalog to scroll through. The artwork stays black and white so the finished palette belongs to the child.

For home and classroom

Download and print the designs for personal activities or classroom coloring. No account is required. These are creative activities, not assessments or promises of educational or health outcomes.
